name: registrar-webapp
description: Registrar in the browser: local-first CPE/CEU tracker with evidence capture.

scripts.e2e:prove-fails: node e2e/verify.mjs --break parser --skip-ocr; test $? -ne 0 && node e2e/verify.mjs --break import --skip-ocr; test $? -ne 0 && node e2e/verify.mjs --break export --skip-ocr; test $? -ne 0 && echo 'all three mutated builds failed, as they must'
scripts.e2e:site:prove-fails: node e2e/site.mjs --break og; test $? -ne 0 && node e2e/site.mjs --break csp; test $? -ne 0 && echo 'both mutated sites failed, as they must'
scripts.fixtures: python3 tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.py && node tests/fixtures/make_image_fixtures.mjs && python3 tests/fixtures/make_image_pdf.py
